verdict.rationale: Nix/NixOS is a package manager and declarative OS, so scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a way to define recurring jobs or workflows. The nearest items are a community mention of enabling auto-gc, which is a built-in maintenance behavior rather than user-defined scheduling, and praise for systemd service configuration, which covers services rather than timers or schedules. Both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
